learning_outcomes.text: Applied knowledge of manufacturing systems and processes, metrology, and quality control.
Applied knowledge of manufacturing systems and processes, metrology, and quality control.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing them with versatility to adapt to new situations.

syllabus_topics: Signal conditioning: Wheatstone bridge, Cold junction for thermocouples, amplifiers, ...
Calibration: sensitivity, hysteresis, accuracy, reproducibility, etc.
Static characteristics of measurement system elements
The accuracy of measurement systems in the steady state
Signals and noise in measurement systems
Reliability, choice and economics of measurement systems
assessment_rules: To pass, a minimum mark of 4 out of 10 in the individual exam and completion of the 3 project reports are compulsory. The final score is calculated as 30% from the exam and 70% from the reports. The rules for the extraordinary call are the same as for the ordinary call.
bibliography: Morris, A.S. and Langari, R. Measurement and Instrumentation. Theory and Application. Elsevier, 2012.
Morris, A. S. Measurement and Instrumentation Principles. 2001.
Labview Manual. Students can find it at the Resources Section (Practical Work sub-section).
